title: Threat Modeling
summary: Runs STRIDE threat modeling, turns threats into testable security requirements, and maps them to controls to find gaps and prioritise mitigations.
changes: Merged three upstream skills (stride-analysis-patterns, security-requirement-extraction, threat-mitigation-mapping) into one, in the order identify threats, extract requirements, map mitigations; their concept sections kept near verbatim
Added STRIDE-per-element, risk scoring and gap rules to the body, stated in prose from the upstream Python templates (impact x likelihood thresholds, 50% coverage, 2+ layers, 2+ control types)

Converted the upstream Python class templates into markdown references (question lists, mitigations, requirement patterns, acceptance criteria, test cases, control library, coverage and roadmap formulas, report templates); no code kept
Kept the STRIDE threat model document template verbatim, fixing its broken nested code fences and the misaligned risk matrix
Removed the compliance control-ID mappings (PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, OWASP ASVS 4.x numbers) because they could not be kept accurate; replaced with an instruction to look IDs up in the framework
Dropped stakeholder/collaboration items (involve stakeholders, don't work in isolation) for a solo user; merged the three Do's/Don'ts lists and removed duplicates
Replaced check/cross symbols in report templates with words
